contentMapping.enemy: 感染装卸工 / 感染搬运工
contentMapping.stageMeaning: Incapacitated and no longer an active combat actor; image does not create a new death, loot or gameplay result.

source.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / precise-object-edit.
Edit the supplied infected freight porter PNG into the SAME man's DISABLED / 失去能力 public combat stage. This means incapacitated and no longer able to act, not an active fighting pose.
Keep exact character identity: same recognizable broad male face, short messy black hair, heavy thickset physique and thick arms, same grey workwear, faded yellow-olive reflective vest, work gloves and work boots. Preserve the full-size anatomical body proportions, head size, shoulder mass and limb widths seen in the input. Do not shrink the person to fit a compact pose; reduce overall pose height only through physically bent knees and collapsed posture.
Pose: incapacitated, slumped down on the ground in a folded kneeling / side-collapsed posture. His knees and one hip rest close to the ground, broad torso droops heavily forward and toward screen-left, head hangs down with face partially visible, one empty gloved hand rests limp near the ground and the other arm is slack against his body. His pose must read as unable to act, not a crouched attack or a ready-to-stand fighter. Keep all body parts coherent and fully visible, no missing limbs. Both hands empty. The boots remain part of the folded body and are visible.
Damage: extensive worn and torn work clothing, frayed vest, ripped sleeves and trouser fabric, grime, non-graphic bruised fatigue. No blood, bleeding, open wounds, exposed tissue, dismemberment or gore. No bandages, new objects, weapons or tools. Do not add dropped loot, a grave, tombstone, death icon, disappearing effect or any narrative symbol.
Canvas and ground: preserve requested full original 1122 × 1402 portrait canvas with true transparent alpha, no auto-trim, crop, re-centering or zoom. Keep his full anatomical scale, let collapsed pose leave much MORE transparent space above the head. Centre the lowered figure near the original standing ground support location. Ground contact support centre should be about pixel (586,1282), the original standing-stage ground baseline. The lowest physical contact parts should sit around y1282–1302. Do not raise the collapsed body into the middle of canvas. This is one stage within a shared ground plane, not a new close-up portrait.
Lighting and medium: same cold realistic painted cinematic material quality and soft cool lighting as source. Complete head, hands, bent legs and boots inside the frame.
Background: TRUE transparent alpha, no painted floor or ground, shadow plane, room, mist, debris, particles, checkerboard, solid backdrop, border, UI, numbers, labels or watermark.
Output exactly ONE non-graphic disabled porter sprite.

alpha.note: True generated alpha preserved. Low-alpha residue reaches bottom edge; visible figure is inset. No crop, cleanup, interpolation or flattening.

display.pose: collapsed kneeling, head down, knees and one hand near ground

registrationAnchors.coordinateSystem: Untrimmed original PNG pixels; normalized coordinates divide by actual source width and height

groundSupportCenter.method: Midpoint of principal folded-knee contact samples: left x300..649 and right x650..899, lowest alpha>=128 row and mean x in bottom four rows. This is a ground-support presentation anchor for the collapsed pose, not standing feet or exact anatomy.

footSupportCenter.method: Midpoint of principal folded-knee contact samples: left x300..649 and right x650..899, lowest alpha>=128 row and mean x in bottom four rows. This is a ground-support presentation anchor for the collapsed pose, not standing feet or exact anatomy.
footSupportCenter.compatibilityNote: Placement-key alias of groundSupportCenter for common wrapper code. This disabled pose is supported by bent legs/knees, not standing feet.

torsoHit.method: Visual torso-centre annotation for presentation registration only. Does not authorize hitting or scheduling an incapacitated enemy.

registrationAnchors.usage: Non-destructive editable wrapper should align groundSupportCenter to the shared stage ground. Preserve original PNG. Do not treat wrapper alignment as naturally matching source pose.

checks.whyNoCodeTests: Independent PNG and metadata only; no application or gameplay changed.
